title: Circular RNA profiling reveals a potential role of hsa_circ_IPCEF1 in papillary thyroid carcinoma.
authors: Guo, Min; Sun, Yushuang; Ding, Junzhu; Li, Yong; Yang, Sihan; Zhao, Yanna; Jin, Xin; Li, Shan-Shan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过微阵列和qPCR分析甲状腺乳头状癌中circRNA表达谱，预测ceRNA网络，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Circular RNAs (circRNAs) are a novel type of non‑coding RNAs that are expressed across species and are implicated in cellular biological processes, displaying dysregulated expression in various tumorigeneses. Therefore, circRNA deregulation could be a crucial event in thyroid carcinoma. The present study identified circRNA signatures in several patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) to complement the understanding of PTC pathogenesis. Using microarray technology, the circRNA profiles in three pairs of PTC tumors and matching adjacent normal tissues were screened. Differentially expressed circRNAs were further validated by reverse transcription‑quantitative PCR in whole blood from 57 pairs of subjects. Bioinformatics data analyses including miRNA response element prediction, Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathway, competing endogenous RNA and KEGG Orthology‑Based Annotation System analyses were performed to predict circRNA associations with cancer‑related putative downstream miRNAs and target genes. Receiver operating characteristic curves and the area under the curve (AUC) values were acquired to assess the performance of validated circRNAs in predicting potential associations with PTC. In total, 158 dysregulated circRNAs were identified in PTC tumors relative to adjacent normal tissues. Notably, one downregulated circRNA (hsa_circ_IPCEF1) showed the preferable predictive power (AUC=0.8010, P<0.0001) and interactions with four cancer‑related genes (CASR, CDC25B, NFkappaB1 and SHOC2). From these analyses, one PTC‑related miRNA (hsa‑miR‑3619‑5p) was identified as a potential target for hsa_circ_IPCEF1 sponging, indicating the hsa_circ_IPCEF1/hsa‑miR‑3619‑5p axis in pathogenesis.
abstract_zh: 环状RNA（circRNAs）是一种新型非编码RNA，在不同物种中均有表达，并参与细胞生物学过程，在多种肿瘤发生中表现出异常表达。因此，circRNA失调可能是甲状腺癌中的一个关键事件。本研究鉴定了数名甲状腺乳头状癌（PTC）患者中的circRNA特征，以补充对PTC发病机制的理解。利用微阵列技术，筛选了三对PTC肿瘤组织及匹配的相邻正常组织中的circRNA谱。差异表达的circRNA进一步通过逆转录定量PCR在57对受试者的全血中进行了验证。进行了包括miRNA反应元件预测、基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书通路、竞争性内源RNA及KEGG直系同源注释系统分析在内的生物信息学数据分析，以预测circRNA与癌症相关推定下游miRNA及靶基因的关联。获取了受试者工作特征曲线及曲线下面积（AUC）值，以评估已验证circRNA在预测与PTC潜在关联中的性能。总共在PTC肿瘤中相对于相邻正常组织鉴定出158个失调的circRNA。值得注意的是，一个下调的circRNA（hsa_circ_IPCEF1）显示出较优的预测能力（AUC=0.8010，P<0.0001），并与四个癌症相关基因（CASR、CDC25B、NFkappaB1和SHOC2）存在相互作用。通过这些分析，一个PTC相关miRNA（hsa‑miR‑3619‑5p）被确定为hsa_circ_IPCEF1海绵吸附的潜在靶标，提示hsa_circ_IPCEF1/hsa‑miR‑3619‑5p轴在发病机制中的作用。
